tooltip.simpletrims.pulsating.color: Colors fade to gray and back
advancements.simpletrims.glow_up.title: Glow Up
advancements.simpletrims.glow_up.descrip: Lay down an armor trim template, hold Glow Ink or Glowstone Dust in the off hand and hit it five times with an axe (with SimpleBuilding: a sledgehammer)
advancements.simpletrims.bright_idea.des: Glowstone Dust instead of Glow Ink turns a trim template into an Emitting one
advancements.simpletrims.full_radiance.d: Add Radiance at the smithing table - Emitting template, armor, Glowstone Dust - until one armor piece shows Radiance 5
simpletrims.guide.page.1.title: Simple Trims
simpletrims.guide.page.1: Glowing, Emitting and Pulsating armor trims, placeable trim templates and forging them with an axe (with SimpleBuilding: the sledgehammer).
simpletrims.guide.page.2.title: Simple Trims
simpletrims.guide.page.2: Sub-mod with the Glowing, Emitting and Pulsating armor trim templates, placeable trim templates
simpletrims.guide.page.3.title: Simple Trims
simpletrims.guide.page.3: and the trim upgrades. Playable on its own (axe); bundled by SimpleBuilding (sledgehammer).
simpletrims.guide.page.4.title: Trim upgrades at the smithing table
simpletrims.guide.page.4: Template + armor + material: Glowing (Glow Ink Sac, once), Radiance (Glowstone Dust, up to level 5), Pulsating (Echo Shard, once). The template is used up like any smithing template.
simpletrims.guide.page.5.title: Placed trim templates
simpletrims.guide.page.5: Sneak + use with any armor trim template lays it flat on the floor, against a wall or under a ceiling. Breaking it gives back exactly that template.
simpletrims.guide.page.6.title: Forging templates: axe or sledgehammer
simpletrims.guide.page.6: A placed Vanilla armor trim template becomes the Glowing one (Glow Ink Sac in the off hand) or the Emitting one (Glowstone Dust):
simpletrims.guide.page.7.title: Forging templates: axe or sledgehammer
simpletrims.guide.page.7: 5 right clicks with the tool, then 2 of the off-hand material, 4 diamonds and 2 glowstone (Glowing) or 2 blaze powder (Emitting) from the inventory.
simpletrims.guide.page.8.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simpletrims.guide.page.8: The templates, their upgrade data, recipes and advancements used to be simplebuilding:*. Old worlds load them as simpletrims:* (SimpleLib id moves); radiance keeps its stored value.
quests.simpletrims.start.title: Welcome to Simple Trims
quests.simpletrims.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simpletrims.start.welcome.title: A free guide
quests.simpletrims.start.welcome.descrip: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Trims Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and a glow ink sac.
